pages.about.html: How it works From analysis to a post Every post starts as numbers from the Cryptophys system and ends as a short, checked text that a person approved. No post is written freely by a model. 1 The system reads the market The Cryptophys system follows XAUUSD on several timeframes. It maps key levels from established metrics (pivots, Camarilla levels, VWAP and others), recognises chart patterns on H1, H4 and D1, and keeps a record of its own decisions. 2 A draft from a fixed template A draft is filled from fixed templates with those numbers only: the zones and the metrics behind them, a pattern's lines and its measured projection, or the day's recap. Decisions are shown only as a recap, 24 hours later. 3 Automatic checks A guardian checks every draft: no buy or sell call, no entry, stop or target, no promised return, no account data, the disclaimer present, the length right for each channel, and TradingView credited when its chart is used. 4 A person approves Posts wait for a person's approval; replies to comments on our posts go out automatically, checked by the same rules. A person reads each draft and approves or rejects it, and the checks run again on approval. 5 Published on each channel's schedule An approved post goes to each channel in its own format, at that channel's posting time, and then appears in the archive . What each post type means Key-level map Zones above and below the price where several metrics agree. A zone is a place to watch, not a place to act. Chart pattern A pattern forming or confirmed on H1, H4 or D1, with its lines and the projection measured from its height. Patterns fail often; the projection is a measurement, not a forecast. Daily recap What the system decided yesterday and how it played out, published after 24 hours so it can never be used as a live signal. What we never post Buy or sell calls, entries, stop losses, take profits or lot sizes Promises of returns or performance claims Account data, positions or anything private News republished from others: only our own short summary, with the source named Charts drawn from other data: the chart is always TradingView's, with its credit visible Education, not financial advice This content is education and analysis. It is not an invitation to buy or sell and not financial advice. Read the full disclaimer
pages.disclaimer.html: Disclaimer Education, not financial advice Please read this before you use anything we publish. What our content is Everything Cryptophys publishes about XAUUSD (gold) on this site and on its channels is education and market analysis. It describes levels, patterns and past decisions of an automated analysis system. What it is not It is not financial advice, investment advice or a recommendation. It is not an invitation or offer to buy or sell gold or any other instrument. It does not take your situation, goals or risk tolerance into account. Risk Trading gold, CFDs and other leveraged products carries a high risk of loss; you can lose more than you expect, and with some products more than your deposit. Levels and patterns fail, and markets can move fast around news and outside normal hours. Past results, including the recaps we publish, do not indicate future results. Your decisions Any decision you make, and its outcome, is entirely your own. Speak with a licensed adviser before you trade. Accuracy We check every post before it goes out, but the analysis can contain errors or be out of date by the time you read it. Decisions appear only as recaps, 24 hours later. Charts and sources Charts are TradingView's, shown with TradingView's credit; our zones and pattern lines are drawn over them. News we refer to is summarised in our own words with the source named.
pages.privacy.html: Privacy Privacy policy What we keep, why, and what we never do. Last updated 25 November 2026. Who we are Cryptophys publishes educational XAUUSD (gold) analysis on this site and on its own social accounts. This policy covers this site (cta.cryptophys.work) and the Cryptophys CTA app, the tool our team uses to prepare, approve and publish those posts. Visitors to this site You can read this site without an account. We do not use advertising or tracking cookies (the TradingView widget described below may set its own), and we do not build profiles of visitors. When you follow one of our tracked links, we count the click per link, channel and day; we do not store your IP address, device or any other detail about you. The live gold price The home page shows a live gold price (XAUUSD) in a small widget served by TradingView, loaded from TradingView's own site once the page has loaded. TradingView may set its own cookies and receives the usual request details for that widget, under its own privacy policy. We receive nothing from it. Social accounts we connect The CTA app connects only to Cryptophys's own accounts on the platforms we publish to (Telegram, Threads, Instagram, X, YouTube and TikTok), through each platform's official login. For each account we keep the access tokens the platform issues, encrypted, and the account's id and display name, so that the app can publish the posts our team approves and read their public metrics (views, likes, comments, shares). We do not read, store or use anyone else's data from these platforms, and we do not access followers' profiles or messages. What we publish Every post is prepared from our own analysis, checked automatically, and approved by a person on our team before it is published. We publish only to the accounts we own. When you reply to one of our posts, we read your reply and your public username to answer it, and keep them for 30 days. Our team Team members sign in to the studio through our identity provider. We keep their email address and their actions in the studio (drafts edited, approvals, publications) to run the studio and keep an audit trail. Sharing We do not sell or share personal data. Posts go only to the platform they are published on. Our infrastructure runs on Cloudflare, which processes requests on our behalf. Retention and removal Tokens are kept until the account is disconnected in the studio, which deletes them; you can also revoke our app's access in the platform's own settings at any time. Drafts, publication records and metrics are kept for the history of our posts. Contact For questions about this policy, contact Cryptophys through any of its official channels linked on this site.
